newsitem.title: USA: CareMatrix Corp reports Q2 full results.
newsitem.headline: CareMatrix Corp reports Q2 full results.

text.p: CarMatrix Corp said its net income for the second quarter of 1997 ended June 30 was $1,228,364, or $0.07 per share, on revenue of $14,930,479.
The company said its net income for the first six months fo 1997 was $2,042,964, or $0.12 per share, on revenue of $28,021,997.
The company said it did not report comparable 1996 results because those results are not applicable since its initial public offering in October 1996.
CareMatrix, formerly Standish Care Co, operates assisted living communities.
